hypothesis: Vendor cmd 0x20000211 validates session in order: auth → nonce → value
test: systematic probing of 0x20000211 with different session types (password, owner, platform, endorsement, PP) and passwords (empty, non-empty)
notes: Empty pw → BAD_AUTH. Non-empty pw → NONCE. Owner/platform/endorsement session (empty pw) → VALUE. PP session → ATTRIBUTES. This suggests 0x20000211 checks: (1) session auth value, (2) session nonce, (3) command value. It is a session validation command.
